caption: The video captures a static macro side view of a single cigarette resting horizontally on a dark, coarse granular surface against a near-black background. The tan filter and the filter-to-paper boundary hold fixed positions throughout, while a column of gray-white ash occupies the right end. A burn line between the white-paper shaft and the ash creeps leftward, shortening the paper section and lengthening the ash column toward the left. The ember at this line pulses in intensity rather than burning evenly, flaring to a bright orange-red glow at moments and fading to a dim gray line in between. Thin, faint wisps of smoke rise intermittently from the burn line and drift upward into the darkness. The ash column changes shape as new ash forms at the burn line, yet no flake is seen detaching and falling.
relations: The burn line creeping leftward consumes the paper shaft, transferring material into the growing ash column.
The pulsing ember at the burn line causes intermittent thin wisps of smoke to rise upward.
The tan filter and boundary remain fixed while the paper shaft shortens and the ash column lengthens.
New ash forms continuously at the advancing burn line, altering the ash column shape without detaching flakes.
